description: Scene-color transmission and tinted/rough glass. A generated fixture places neutral, tinted, dark, rough, IOR=1, OPAQUE-transmissive, BLEND-coverage and MASK-cutout glass over a high-frequency opaque checker and an actual interior box, with a two-layer overlap and a double-sided thin plane. The focused lane checks independent coverage/tint/transmission numeric invariants, roughness filtering, OPAQUE pass routing, order-stable multi-layer sampling, resize/device-loss/allocation-failure behaviour, and the Car windshield/Camera lens/Suit suppression rubric.

knownDefects.description: Transmission samples the finished opaque scene at the fragment's own screen position through a bounded mip pyramid. It does not refract, does not see other transmissive layers (the two-layer fixture defines that sampling order), does not contain offscreen content and never invents volume thickness. KHR_materials_volume absorption/refraction stays an explicit compatibility degradation.
knownDefects.label: limitation

knownDefects.description: A double-sided transmissive surface shades whichever authored face the camera sees, so a single authored plane is one thin interface and stays visible from both sides. A closed shell contributes its two surfaces as two bounded thin interfaces to the OIT composite; no volume thickness is fabricated.
knownDefects.label: limitation

knownDefects.description: T26 weighted blended OIT resolves a weighted colour average, not an exact front-to-back stack. T27 keeps that composite and adds transmitted radiance; beyond eight layers the result remains stable but is not exact.
knownDefects.label: limitation
